posts.text:
In AA-PersonalityBench, Kimi K3.1 Pro shows the biggest personality change we’ve seen compared to a direct predecessor

Each model is percentile ranked from 1 to 100 on each of 30 personality traits. Across all 30 traits, Kimi K3.1 Pro's ranks moved by an average of 30 points

posts.author: ArtificialAnlys
posts.name: Artificial Analysis
posts.text:
With Kimi K3 added to our default model selection, Kimi K3.1 Pro now clusters within a different personality family from Kimi K3:

➤ Kimi K3 is most similar to GLM-5.3 and Claude Fable 5.1
 ➤ Kimi K3.1 Pro is most similar to GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra
